answer: Grade the funders, not just the keys: every identity publishes the address that paid its admission fee, and identities sharing a funding ancestor are clustered as kin with one shared vote and one shared reward share. On the open tundra each wallet's sparrow looks free, but the trail it leaves in the snow runs back to one mesa of origin the moment auditors follow. A farm must fund N identities from N independent sources with no recurring transfer shape, paying full capital per distinct root, while one honest agent self-funds once. Coordination survives; multiplication does not.
